scripts.build:sepolia: node scripts/sync-networks.js base-sepolia && graph build --network base-sepolia
scripts.build:mainnet: node scripts/sync-networks.js base && graph build --network base
scripts.test:docker: docker build -t matchstick . && docker run -it --rm -v "%cd%\..\..":/workspace matchstick
scripts.deploy:local: node scripts/sync-networks.js localhost && pnpm codegen && graph deploy --node http://localhost:8020/ --ipfs http://localhost:5001 ticketpulse/subgraph --network localhost --network-file networks.local.json --version-label v0.0.1
scripts.deploy:studio:sepolia: node scripts/sync-networks.js base-sepolia && pnpm codegen && graph deploy --studio ticketpulse-sepolia --network base-sepolia
scripts.deploy:studio:mainnet: node scripts/sync-networks.js base && pnpm codegen && graph deploy --studio ticketpulse --network base
